name: Hanging Windshield Wiper
instructions: Grip a pull-up bar and hang, then raise your straight legs up until your feet are near the bar.
Keeping your legs together and your shoulders still, rotate your hips and lower your legs toward one side in a wide arc.
Bring your legs back up through the middle and lower them to the other side.
Keep the movement slow and controlled. Do not swing, and build up with easier hanging core work first.
image_prompt_scene: Hanging from a bar with the legs raised straight up to the bar.
